SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Confirm that a current guide and transfer arrangement exist before buying specialist travel gear. Pack to the actual transport allowance and ask which personal equipment is unavailable locally.

Treat each target as its own system

Ask the guide for the rod, reel, line, leader and fly requirements for the chosen target. Confirm whether the day is skiff-based, waded or a combination. Choose footwear from that access decision, and do not substitute a light target outfit for a heavy predator system.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Bahamas

Anglers aged 12 and older need a personal licence for flats fishing. A foreign-owned boat also needs a sport fishing permit; the boat permit does not replace the flats licence.

  • Day of issueVisitor flats daily
  • 1 weekVisitor flats weekly
  • 1 monthVisitor flats monthly
  • 1 yearVisitor flats annual
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Foreign-owned vessel sport fishing permit ↗
    Operators of foreign-owned vessels used for sport fishing. Arrange the vessel permit through Bahamas Customs or Marine Resources.

Rules for this water

  • A certified guide is required when two or more anglers fish the flats from a vessel.
  • Do not use a speargun or sell fish caught on the flats.

Full Bahamas licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
